lines.en: label ayanenew2:
scene ayanenewtwo1
: Ahh! Seven losses in a row. I swear Miss Osaka, it’s like you’ve been doing this for your entire life or something.
lines.zh: : 啊！连输七场。我发誓，Osaka 老师，你就像一辈子都在干这个似的。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. If you were able to beat me at all, I’d probably just hang it up and open a flower shop or something.
lines.zh: : 我是说……对。你要是真能赢我哪怕一次，我大概就挂起来、去开家花店什么的了。

lines.en: : I somehow have a hard time picturing that.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么，我很难想象那个画面。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo2
: Good. Keep me as far away from your fantasies as possible.
lines.zh: : 很好。把我放得离你的幻想越远越好。

lines.en: The three of us are relaxing in the dojo after a mildly eventful training session in which Ayane and I both gave it our all.
lines.zh: 在一场还算热闹的训练之后，我们三个正在道场里休息——那场训练里 Ayane 和我都拼尽了全力。

lines.en: : Oh, and if you go one more class without doing anything, I’m going to beat your ass without even giving you a warning first.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，要是你再有一节课什么都不干，我会连警告都不给就揍你一顿。

lines.en: The three of us are relaxing in the dojo after a mildly eventful training session in which Ayane gave it her all.
lines.zh: 在一场还算热闹的训练之后，我们三个正在道场里休息——那场训练里 Ayane 拼尽了全力。

lines.en: Unfortunately, her all was not even close to enough and now she is extremely exhausted from overexerting herself- meaning her virginity will likely survive at least one more day while she recovers.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，她的全力远远不够，而现在她因为过度透支而极度疲惫——这意味着她的处女身大概能再多保住一天，等她恢复。

lines.en: If she recovers, that is. Because I’ve had this same exact inner monologue several times today, and each one has ended with another-
lines.zh: 如果她恢复得了的话。因为我今天已经有过好几次一模一样的内心独白了，而每一次都以另一场——

lines.en: : One more round. I can do it this time. And...I won’t even make you give me a handicap again! That’s how confident I am!
lines.zh: : 再来一局。这次我能行。而且……我甚至不用你再让我了！我就是这么有信心！

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo3
: Fuck no. I’ve already spent pretty much the entire day with you. It’s not fair to the rest of the girls.
lines.zh: : 他妈的不行。我已经跟你耗了差不多一整天了。这对其他女孩不公平。

lines.en: : Besides, if I wind up hurting one of the richest girls in the entire city from pushing her too hard, your father will run this place into the ground.
lines.zh: : 再说，要是我把你逼得太狠、把全城最富有的女孩之一给弄伤了，你父亲会把这地方拆得渣都不剩。

lines.en: : I can’t afford a legal battle with...whatever the hell your dad’s name is.
lines.zh: : 我可打不起跟……随便你爸叫什么鬼名字的人打官司。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo4
: Nice try, Miss Osaka. But I’ve already told you that Sensei is my dad.
lines.zh: : 想得美，Osaka 老师。可我说过了，Sensei 就是我爸爸。

lines.en: : That would be a little more believable if you stopped referring to him as “Sensei,” which, honestly, you shouldn’t be doing at all since I am Sensei while we’re in here.
lines.zh: : 你要是不再叫他「Sensei」的话，这话可信度会高一点——说实话你根本不该那么叫，因为我们在这儿的时候我才是 Sensei。

lines.en: : What would I be called, then?
lines.zh: : 那我该叫你什么？

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo5
: Oh, I don’t know. Maybe your fucking name?
lines.zh: : 哦，我不知道。也许你他妈的名字？

lines.en: : Can I ask you something, Miss Osaka?
lines.zh: : 我能问你件事吗，Osaka 老师？

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo6
: For the last time, no. I will not teach your chicken karate.
lines.zh: : 最后一次，不行。我不会教你的鸡爪空手道。

lines.en: : While I implore you to reconsider, that’s not what I was going to ask.
lines.zh: : 虽然我恳请你再考虑一下，不过我要问的不是这个。

lines.en: : I just want to know why, if you know Sensei isn’t my real dad...you’re letting the two of us continue to show up together.
lines.zh: : 我只想知道：既然你知道 Sensei 不是我亲爸……你为什么还让我们俩继续一起来。

lines.en: : I care more about the fact that he does literally nothing here than the fact that he also happens to be your teacher.
lines.zh: : 我更在意的是他在这儿 literally 什么都不干，而不是他恰好也是你老师这件事。

lines.en: : If he even...is your teacher and that’s not just some weird pet name he’s making you refer to him as.
lines.zh: : 如果他真的……是你老师，而那不只是他让你这么称呼他的某种怪昵称。

lines.en: : What kind of person do you think I am?
lines.zh: : 你把我当成什么人了？

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo7
: “Person” is generous. I don’t think you’ve earned the right to call yourself that yet.
lines.zh: : 「人」这个词都算抬举了。我觉得你还没挣到这么称呼自己的资格。

lines.en: : Okay, Ayane. It’s time to find a new instructor.
lines.zh: : 好了，Ayane。是时候找个新教练了。

lines.en: : Good luck. Nobody in this city comes even close to the level I’m at. Which I guess you don’t care about, but I’m sure Amamiya does.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运。这座城里没人能接近我的水平。这个你大概不在乎，不过我敢肯定天雨在乎。

lines.en: : To get back on track...he really is my teacher. But we’ve also known each other for a really long time, so...
lines.zh: : 说回正题……他真是我老师。不过我们也认识很久了，所以……

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo8
: I guess that kind of explains why you two act so “friendly” all the time, then.
lines.zh: : 我想那大概能解释你俩为什么一直表现得这么「亲密」了。

lines.en: : Friendly? I mean...I don’t know if I’d call us friends...
lines.zh: : 亲密？我是说……我不知道该不该叫我们朋友……

lines.en: : There are definitely other words I’d use in place of that, but saying any of them out loud might make me throw up in my mouth and that would be...unprofessional or something.
lines.zh: : 肯定有别的一些词我可以拿来代替，不过把它们任何一个说出口都可能让我在嘴里吐出来，而那会……不专业什么的。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo9
: To be frank, your entire relationship confuses the shit out of me. It’s just not really my place to get involved when, at least so far, it’s seemed mostly innocent.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，你们整段关系把我搞糊涂透了。只是这实在不该我插手——至少到目前为止，它看起来大体上是干净的。

lines.en: : If Amamiya seemed genuinely creeped out or something, I’d be a lot more concerned. But, if anything, it kind of seems like she’s the pursuer and not Sensei over here.
lines.zh: : 要是天雨真的一脸被 creep 到的样子，我会担心得多。可要说的话，看起来反倒是她在追，而不是这边的老师。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo10
: That’s accurate. I’ve been pursuing Sensei for quite some time now as the two of us are destined to be together one day.
lines.zh: : 准确。我追求 Sensei 已经有一段时间了，因为我们俩注定有一天要在一起。

lines.en: : See, this is the kind of shit that I don’t want to hear because now it’s a hell of a lot weirder.
lines.zh: : 瞧，就是这种鬼话我不想听——因为现在这事他妈的怪多了。

lines.en: : The world needs to know.
lines.zh: : 世界需要知道。

lines.en: : Well, don’t lump me in with the rest of the world. I’m here to teach karate, not offer relationship counseling.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别把我和「世界」归在一起。我是来教空手道的，不是来做感情咨询的。

lines.en: : Much like the flower shop job, you don’t really seem fit for that either.
lines.zh: : 就像那个花店的活儿一样，你看着也不像适合干这个。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo11
: Hey! I’ll have you know that I’ve been in a very successful relationship for quite some time now!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我得让你知道，我处在一段非常成功的感情里已经有一段时间了！

lines.en: : You mean with karate?
lines.zh: : 你是说跟空手道？

lines.en: : No! I mean with a live, human being!
lines.zh: : 不！我是说跟一个活生生的、人类！

lines.en: : The fact that you had to specify “live” makes me a little wary of this alleged partner of yours.
lines.zh: : 你得特别说明「活生生的」这一点，让我对你这位所谓伴侣有点发毛。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo12
: Okay! Time for your turn to spar, smartass.
lines.zh: : 好！该你上场对打了，自作聪明的家伙。

lines.en: : I don’t think Sensei and I need counseling right now, but I’ll keep you in mind if we ever do, Miss Osaka.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我和 Sensei 现在不需要咨询，不过要是哪天需要，我会想起你的，Osaka 老师。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo13
: Why? I literally just said that I’m not here to do stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我 literally 刚说了我不是来干那种事的。

lines.en: : It’s just that you seem really happy most of the time, so I am assuming your relationship must be going pretty strong.
lines.zh: : 只是你大部分时间看起来都很幸福，所以我猜你的感情一定挺稳固的。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo14
: W-Well, it’s...I guess we are pretty good together...but we’ve also known each other for a really long time and-
lines.zh: : 呃——那个……我想我们在一起挺好的……不过我们也认识很久了，而且——

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo15
: Wait, why am I even talking about this with you two?!
lines.zh: : 等等，我为什么要跟你们俩聊这个？！

lines.en: : Because...we want to hear about your amazing and successful relationship?
lines.zh: : 因为……我们想听听你那了不起又成功的感情？

lines.en: : It’s amazing and successful! There you go! Conversation over!
lines.zh: : 它了不起又成功！给，话放这儿！谈话结束！

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo16
: Now, pack your stuff and get ready to leave! We’ve only got ten minutes left of class and I still have to make up for all of the time everyone else lost during the seven ass-kickings I gave you.
lines.zh: : 现在，收拾东西准备走！课只剩十分钟了，我还得把我揍你的那七顿里别人耽误的时间补回来。

lines.en: So...the instructor is in a relationship.
lines.zh: 所以……教练在谈恋爱。

lines.en: I can’t say I saw that coming.
lines.zh: 我不能说我早看出来了。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say I don’t find her attractive or anything- she certainly has her own brand of...tomboyish charm.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我没觉得她有吸引力什么的——她自有她那种……男孩子气的魅力。

lines.en: She just doesn’t really seem like the type to fawn over someone based on first impressions alone.
lines.zh: 她只是看起来不像那种光凭第一印象就会对人神魂颠倒的类型。

lines.en: But if every book on every shelf mirrored its cover, libraries would be a lot less exciting.
lines.zh: 可要是每本书都跟封面一模一样，图书馆就没那么有意思了。

lines.en: So I guess it’s good that people like her exist and remind us that not everything is always as it seems.
lines.zh: 所以我想，有她这种人存在、提醒我们并非一切都如表象，是件好事。

lines.en: : Sensei-
lines.zh: : 老师——

lines.en: Though, of course-
lines.zh: 当然——

lines.en: Some things are.
lines.zh: 有些事就是。

lines.en: : Yes, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Ayane？

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo17
: Are you surprised to find out that Miss Osaka is dating somebody?
lines.zh: : 发现 Osaka 老师在跟人交往，你意外吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It ruins my plan of asking her to marry me after beating her in a sparring match.
lines.zh: : 意外。这毁了我打算在对打赢她之后向她求婚的计划。

lines.en: : Normally, I’d worry after hearing something like that. But after going seven rounds with her today, I can pretty much confirm that there’s no reason to worry at all.
lines.zh: : 正常情况下听到这种话我会担心。不过今天跟她打了七轮之后，我基本可以确认完全没必要担心。

lines.en: : Is she really that tough?
lines.zh: : 她真有那么强？

lines.en: : Have you ever tried to punch a bird out of the sky before?
lines.zh: : 你试过一拳把天上的鸟打下来吗？

lines.en: : Neither have I, but I imagine it’s kind of like that.
lines.zh: : 我也没有，不过我想大概就是那种感觉。

lines.en: : She’s super fast and pretty much impossible to hit. And when she hits you, it’s way harder than you expect it to be.
lines.zh: : 她超快，而且几乎打不中。而她打到你的时候，比你预想的要重得多。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo18
: I wonder if that’s what loving her is like as well?
lines.zh: : 我在想，爱她是不是也是那种感觉？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that wasn’t meant to be a sexual innuendo, but I’m going to imagine it as one.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定那话本意不是性暗示，不过我要把它当成一句来想象。

lines.en: : I mean, I guess that would be part of it. But yeah, I’m talking more along the lines of just...having something that real, you know?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我想那也算其中一部分。不过我说的更多是……拥有那样真实的东西，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Do you...
Don’t ask it, Ayane.
lines.zh: 别问，Ayane。

lines.en: : Do you think...
lines.zh: : 你觉得……

lines.en: : Do you think that we’ll ever have something like that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们有一天会拥有那样东西吗？

lines.en: Of course not.
lines.zh: 当然不会。

lines.en: All it would take is one look at us to know that something like that isn’t possible.
lines.zh: 只要看我们一眼，就知道那样的事不可能。

lines.en: And, on the off chance it ever would be, it would take us years to get there.
lines.zh: 而万一真有可能，我们也要花上几年才能走到那儿。

lines.en: Time is not known to be kind to the segmented nature of unblossomed, unrequited love.
lines.zh: 时间对未开花、无回应的爱那种层层分段的本质，从不出名地仁慈。

lines.en: And so there is no way that this girl and I will ever be happy together.
lines.zh: 所以这个女孩和我，永远不可能在一起幸福。

lines.en: The same goes for everyone else who falls as deep into this hole as her.
lines.zh: 其他像她一样深陷这个洞里的人也一样。

lines.en: I am not built for love-
lines.zh: 我不是为爱而造的——

lines.en: But I was built by someone somewhere.
lines.zh: 可我是由某个地方的某个人造出来的。

lines.en: So I will try on new goals as if they are outfits and peer into the glass, hoping that whatever is reflected back at me looks closer to something with purpose.
lines.zh: 所以我会像试衣服一样试穿新的目标，然后凑到镜子前，盼着映回来的东西看起来更接近某种有目的的东西。

lines.en: Or, at the very least-
lines.zh: 或者至少——

lines.en: Something not far from fantasy.
lines.zh: 离幻想不远的东西。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo19
: On second thought...don’t answer that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 再想想……别回答那个，老师。

lines.en: : It was a stupid question.
lines.zh: : 那是个蠢问题。

lines.en: : It wasn’t a stupid question, it-
lines.zh: : 不是蠢问题，它——

lines.en: : No, it was.
lines.zh: : 不，就是。

lines.en: : And honestly, it’s stupid that I asked in the first place since I’ve known from the beginning that we could never have anything like that.
lines.zh: : 而且老实说，我一开始就问这个才蠢，因为我从一开始就知道我们不可能拥有那样东西。

lines.en: : It’s one of the many unfortunate side effects of falling for someone the world doesn’t want you with.
lines.zh: : 这是爱上了一个世界不让你在一起的人，众多不幸副作用之一。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo20
: But...I’m okay with that.
lines.zh: : 可是……我接受。

lines.en: : And sure, we might not ever have something amazing and successful by everyday standards, but that doesn’t mean it won’t be amazing and successful to us.
lines.zh: : 当然，按世俗标准我们也许永远不会拥有什么了不起、成功的东西，可那不意味着它对我们而言不会了不起、不成功。

lines.en: : Isn’t that what really matters? That we’re happy?
lines.zh: : 真正重要的不就是我们幸福吗？

lines.en: : Do you actually think you’d be happy with me, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得跟我在一起你会幸福吗，Ayane？

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo21
: Yes.
: You didn’t even think-
lines.zh: : 你连想都没——

lines.en: : I don’t have to think, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不用想，老师。

lines.en: : There are some things in life that you just know.
lines.zh: : 有些事你就是知道。

lines.en: : This is one of those things.
lines.zh: : 这就是其中一件。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo22
: So, you can deny it all you want or think to yourself that there’s no real way for us to be happy, but I know that I’m happier than I’ve ever been just getting to say these things to you.
lines.zh: : 所以，你可以想否认就否认，也可以觉得我们根本没有真正幸福的可能，但我知道：光是能对你说这些，我就比以往任何时候都幸福。

lines.en: : And I know that there’s next to nothing you can do to change that, whether you want to or not.
lines.zh: : 而且我也知道，不管你想不想，你几乎没法改变这一点。

lines.en: scene ayanenewtwo23
: I’m kind of like a disease you’ll have to live with for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 我有点像一种你得带着过完余生的病。

lines.en: : That is a significantly more grotesque note than I expected that mini-monologue to end on.
lines.zh: : 这结尾比我预想的这段小独白要恶心多了。

lines.en: : Same here, but I really couldn’t think of any other way to put it.
lines.zh: : 我也是，不过我真的想不出别的说法了。

lines.en: : Things will never be normal between us. And very few people will ever accept it because its face value isn’t covered up by the masks they expect us to wear.
lines.zh: : 我们之间永远不会正常。而且几乎没人会接受，因为它的表面没有被他们期待我们戴上的面具盖住。

lines.en: : But one day, the two of us will be standing in front of a mirror together.
lines.zh: : 但有一天，我们俩会一起站在一面镜子前。

lines.en: : Your hands will either be on my shoulders or my belly assuming that I’m pregnant, which I probably will be-
lines.zh: : 你的手会搭在我肩上，或者我的肚子上——假设我怀孕了，而我大概会的——

lines.en: : And what’s reflected back at us will be something with purpose. Something no one thought would ever work out.
lines.zh: 而映回来的，会是某种有目的的东西。某种没人认为能成的事。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : I’ll make it work, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我会让它成的，老师。

lines.en: : I promise I’ll make it work.
lines.zh: : 我保证会让它成。

lines.en: scene black
I’m not sure how, but Ayane managed to tap into the same worries I had just moments ago when contemplating the unlikely future the two of us may have.
lines.zh: 我不知道怎么做到的，但 Ayane 触及了我刚才在设想我们俩那不大可能的未来时，心里同样那些担忧。

lines.en: And while it would be easy to chalk that strain of hivemind up to the fact that she’s known me for years, I can’t help but feel like there’s a little more to it than that.
lines.zh: 虽然把这种「同频」归结为她认识我很多年很容易，可我忍不住觉得背后还有更多东西。

lines.en: Love as pure as hers has no right to exist in the world-
lines.zh: 像她那样纯粹的爱，本没有权利存在于这个世界上——

lines.en: But neither do I.
lines.zh: 可我也没有。

lines.en: And if the fact that I can wake up and step into a world that doesn’t want me is a symbol that things in life may happen without a reason, I have no right to say what can or can’t exist.
lines.zh: 而如果「我能醒来、踏进一个并不想要我的世界」这件事，象征着人生中有些事可以毫无理由地发生，那我就没有权利去说什么能、什么不能存在。

lines.en: Not that I ever did in the first place, it’s just-
lines.zh: 倒不是说我本来就有那个权利，只是——

lines.en: I’m not built for love.
lines.zh: 我不是为爱而造的。

lines.en: But that doesn’t mean no one else was.
lines.zh: 可那不意味着没有别人是为爱而造的。

lines.en: $ ayane_love += 1
$ ayanenew2 = True
Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!
lines.zh: Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
